abilities.critical_failure: The creature takes double damage, is knocked prone, and takes 1d12 persistent bleed damage as it scrapes across the Ox’s scales.
abilities.effect: The Granite Ox tosses its head. Creatures in the area 2d12+13 bludgeoning damage must attempt a DC 29 Fortitude saving throw. The hazard rolls initiative.
abilities.failure: The creature takes full damage and is knocked prone.
abilities.name: Toss
abilities.trigger: A creature reaches the Granite Ox’s head or attempts a skill check to disable the hazard

hazard.description: The head of the Granite Ox tosses back and forth as the creature charges toward Dhuraxilis.
hazard.disable: DC 27 Athletics (master) to tug one of the ox’s ears, DC 32 Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion (expert) to distract the Ox with a display of magic, or DC 35 Acrobatics (expert) to dangle in front of the Ox’s eyes and obscure its vision; three successes are required to disable the hazard
hazard.name: By the Horns
hazard.reset: The hazard ends automatically after 5 rounds or once all PCs are thrown from the Ox’s back, whichever comes first.
hazard.routine: (1 action) The Granite Ox bucks. Each creature on the Ox’s head must attempt a DC 33 Reflex save. Prone creatures gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the save. On a failure, the creature falls prone. On a critical failure, the creature flies from the Ox’s back, falling 120 feet to the ground or into Kardaji Bay.

traits.name: Unique
traits.text: A rules element with this trait is one-of-a-kind. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to creatures with this trait is increased by 10.

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.

traits.name: Mythic
traits.text:
Options with this trait grant or utilize mythic power. Feats with the mythic trait can only be taken by mythic characters, who are typically characters with a mythic Calling.  
  
 Monsters with the mythic trait have access to a pool of Mythic Points and are particularly strong for creatures of their level. Many mythic monsters are either resistant or entirely immune to attacks from non-mythic creatures and weapons.  
  
 Spells with the mythic trait require the expenditure of a Mythic Point in order to be cast, and items with the mythic trait require the expenditure of a Mythic Point in order to use their activated abilities.  
  
 Weapons with the mythic trait overcome the resistances and immunities of mythic monsters.
